facts.statement: Welcommia is an extinct genus of shark.
facts.quote: Welcommia is an extinct genus of shark.

facts.statement: The species Welcommia bodeuri was described by H. Cappetta in 1990 from Late Jurassic fossils in France.
facts.quote: Welcommia bodeuri H. Cappetta, 1990 (Late Jurassic of France)

facts.statement: The species Welcommia cappettai was described by Stefanie Klug and Jürgen Kriwet in 2010 from middle Oxfordian fossils in Germany.
facts.quote: Welcommia cappettai Stefanie Klug and Jürgen Kriwet, 2010 (middle Oxfordian of Germany)

facts.statement: The species Welcommia terencei was described by D. Delsate and P. Godefroit in 1995 from Jurassic fossils in Belgium.
facts.quote: Welcommia terencei D. Delsate and P. Godefroit, 1995 (Jurassic of Belgium)

facts.statement: Welcommia belongs to the parent group Pseudonotidanidae.
Welcommia is classified in the family Pseudonotidanidae.
Welcommia is a member of the class Chondrichthyes.
Welcommia bodeuri is the type species of the genus Welcommia.
Welcommia lived during the Valanginian stage, between 137.05 and 132.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Valanginian to Valanginian (137.05 to 132.6 million years ago)

facts.statement: The fossil range of Welcommia is the Jurassic period.
